name: duopore-public-kpi-period-comparison
description: Compare business results across two periods and see which numbers moved toward your goal.

interface.longDescription: Compare business results across two periods and see which numbers moved toward your goal. Enter old and new values and whether higher or lower is better for each measure. Get number changes and percentages where the maths allows them. It uses only your figures and does not guess causes. A zero starting value has no percentage change.
defaultPrompt: Compare these business measures with the previous period.
Which numbers moved toward or away from my chosen goal?

positive.prompt: Use KPI Period Comparison with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"previousPeriod":"September","currentPeriod":"October","metrics":[{"id":"K1","label":"Qualified enquiries","previous":100,"current":120,"desiredDirection":"higher"},{"id":"K2","label":"New channel leads","previous":0,"current":5,"desiredDirection":"higher"}]}

No data source connection, statistical inference or business outcome guarantee.","Percentage change divides by the absolute previous value; negative baselines require contextual review.","Percentage change is undefined at a zero baseline or outside the supported numeric range; the absolute change remains available."]}

review.commerce_description: Free useful computation. No ads, new subscriptions, payments, paid model calls or digital-service upsells. Separate commercial hypotheses are internal planning only.
